factual_fidelity.evidence: Title says 'zentraler Lag' (central location) and body says 'am Häerz vun der Gemeng' — Mamer not stated and 'central' is unsupported.

completeness.evidence: 'dräi schënne Schlofkummeren an engem propperen Bad' covers beds/bath, '130 m²' present, but no price and no Mamer.

native_quality.evidence: 'engem sécheren Holzläffel als Lagerplaz' (Holzläffel = wooden spoon) is a clearly wrong word; 'schnellewäertege Beräich' is also nonsensical.

market_fit.evidence: Mixed odd compounds like 'Zousazparkplang' and 'schnellewäertege Beräich' do not match LU real-estate corpus.

compliance_cpe.evidence: No Energieklass / CPE mentioned in the Luxembourgish text.

seo_signal.evidence: Title 'Charmant Familljenhaus mat privatem Gaart an zentraler Lag' falsely claims central location and lacks Mamer; hashtags are English.

tone_discipline.evidence: 'Dëst Paradäis am Gaart' (paradise) is hyperbolic for an entry-tier rental.

fair_housing.evidence: 'ideal fir Famillje oder Leit, déi eng präsenz an engem rouegen... Quartier sichen' explicitly targets families.

hallucination.evidence: 'am Häerz vun der Gemeng' and 'zentraler Lag' invent a central location not in inputs; Mamer is absent but a different location ('central') is fabricated.

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: FR title says 'à Luxembourg', LU says 'zentraler Lag' / 'am Häerz vun der Gemeng', EN and DE omit neighborhood entirely — none agree on location; only FR mentions price (2 900 €/mois).

notes: HARD-FAIL fair_housing (family targeting); also fabricates 'central' location and contains lexical errors.
